language.title: Choose language
language.optionNote: Local place names stay as Bruneians say them
language.changeLater: You can change this in Settings.

location.title: Why we need your location
location.intro: Your phone will ask next. Here is what Laluan Kitani does with it.
location.whereBody: So turn-by-turn directions start from you.
location.warnBody: Floods, jams and closures on your route.
location.privacy: Only shared with others when you turn on Share trip.

map.offline: Can't reach Laluan Kitani. Reports may be out of date.
map.webOffline: Map preview needs an internet connection in Expo Go.

search.title: Search
search.hint: Try a local name, a simpang number, or what you need, like "passport" or "solat".
search.simpangManyRoads: {{count}} roads have a Simpang {{number}}. Add the jalan name to narrow it down.

place.title: Place
place.notFound: This place is no longer on the map.
place.busyTimesNote: Shaded hours are Peak Spot windows on the way here.

status.closedToday: Closed for the rest of today

saved.title: Saved places
saved.noFavourites: Save places you go to often from their details page, or tap Add.
saved.onThisPhone: Saved places stay on this phone. Sign in to keep them if you change phones.
saved.chooseOnMapNote: For a house or a spot that isn't listed
saved.pinNote: The pin marks the spot. Tap a name on the map to use that place. Only you can see it.

report.title: Report
report.descriptionPlaceholder: Add a short note when you're parked
report.drivingNow: You're moving. Add a note when stopped.
report.thanks: Thanks for the report. Other drivers can see it now.

errors.noLocation: We don't know where you are yet. Move the map to the spot and try again.
errors.tooMany: You've sent a lot of reports. Try again in a little while.
errors.outsideBrunei: Reports can only be made in Brunei.

report.hintDrag: Move the map so the pin is on the spot
report.hintMoving: You are driving: the report goes where you are

reportDetail.youSaidStillThere: You said it's still there. Thank you.
reportDetail.youSaidGone: You said it's gone. Thank you.
reportDetail.yours: This is your report. Other drivers confirm it.
reportDetail.gone: This report has ended or been cleared.
reportDetail.clearedThanks: Thanks. Drivers agree it's gone, so it's off the map.

why.report: Reports need an account so we can stop spam and thank the drivers who help. Everything else works without one.
why.profile: An account lets you post and confirm reports. Everything else works without one.

signIn.codeNote: We send a 6-digit code. No password to remember.
signIn.devCode: Development build: email isn't set up yet, so your code is {{code}}
signIn.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
signIn.nicknameWhy: Other drivers see this on your reports, never your email.
signIn.privacy: By continuing you agree to the Privacy policy. We never post anything for you.

errors.invalid_code: That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.too_many_requests: Please wait a little before asking for another code.
errors.nickname_taken: That nickname is taken. Try another.
errors.account_unavailable: This account can't sign in. Contact us if you think that's a mistake.
errors.generic: Something's not right. Check what you entered and try again.

profile.signedOutBody: Sign in to post and confirm reports. Search, the map and saved places work without an account.
profile.needsNicknameBody: Pick a nickname to start reporting.
profile.toNextLevel: {{points}} points to {{level}}. Confirmed reports earn the most.
profile.topLevel: Top level. Thank you for looking after other drivers.
profile.thanksBody_one: Your report this month helped other drivers. Thank you.
profile.thanksBody_other: Your {{count}} reports this month helped other drivers. Thank you.
profile.thanksEmpty: Seen a jam, flood or closed road? One tap on Report warns every driver behind you.

settings.title: Settings
settings.clearHistoryConfirm: Remove your recent searches from this phone?
settings.deleteBody: Your nickname and email are deleted and you are signed out. Your past reports stay on the map without your name. Saved places and search history on this phone are removed too. This cannot be undone.
settings.deletedBody: Thank you for helping other drivers.

route.fromDevStandIn: From · Gadong (test start: your location is not in Brunei)
route.needLocation: Allow location to plan a route from where you are.
route.notInBrunei: Routes start from your location, and it is not in Brunei.
route.noRoute: No route found to this place.
route.unavailable: Routing is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
route.closureAtEndpoint: A closed road is at the start or end of this trip. The route still goes there; check the reports.

step.roundabout_onto: At the roundabout, take exit {{exit}} onto {{road}}

arrived.title: You've arrived
arrived.thanksAnswer: Thanks. This helps us improve routes.
arrived.avoided_one: Drivers' reports kept you away from a closed or flooded road today.
arrived.avoided_other: Drivers' reports kept you away from {{count}} closed or flooded roads today.

spot.notice: From the map. This place isn't in Laluan Kitani yet, so its opening hours and local names aren't known.
